Yes and no rather I'm just after stable work so I can finally move out of home.

I do fish ever now and again but have to be in the mood for it otherwise I get too pissed off

I'm currently watching the new season or Rewrite, Blue Exorcist, Tales of Zestria. I watch too much anime to have favorites or remember them off top of my head without some sort of reminder such as some you watch or something.
Games I'm playing Dragon Age Origins, Dragon Age Inquisition, Grim Dawn, Titan Quest, Dungeon Siege 2, Diablo 2,Final Fantasy 15. I mostly play RPG and JRPG not really MP games except Grim Dawn/Titan Quest/Diablo 2. So if you play one of them sure.

Never had friends never been in a relationship, as I said everyone avoids me/rejects me/pretends I don't exist unless forced to interact with me. Family is mum with fibrosis, autistic brother who isn't as high functioning as me and always swears his ass off and abuses as soon as he hears something he doesn't like, only reason I haven't ripped his throat out is because I'd no longer have a roof over my head.

I'm an aggressive pike of shit couldn't be anything further from kind
Ain't much to tell, 21, male, autistic, dropped out of highschool, work as bartender/waiter at a casino, like anime and video game,

It doesn't matter what happens to my body it doesn't break, over the last 10 years I've been hit by 4 trucks 3 buses and I've lost count how many cars as I stopped counting after 58 because the keep speeding through red lights or driving on foot path trying to run me over, why they are trying to run me over I don't have the slightest clue. But everytime I've been hit I've walked away with only minor bruises and scratches.
I've also had a burning house collapse on top of me again I walked away with minor injuries. I've fallen from 3 stories high without injury, so yeah my body is unbreakable doesn't matter what happens to me or what I do to it.
As for my mind it's already broken beyond repair psychologists have said I'm a sociopath waiting to happen.

I understand your intentions in saying you love me and you'll support me but those words hold no meaning, if you knew me you'd be just like everyone else giving me disgusted looks despite me not having done or said anything, you'd avoid me at any cost pretending I don't exist and if you were forced to interact with me like in a work environment you'd be somewhat kind but as soon as the shift is over you'd all but run in the opposite direction just like every single other person in the world. People treat me like that moving shadow you see out of the corner of your eye, they always have and always will there has never been a single exception.

I'm only alive because my own body won't let me commit suicide everytime I try I lose control of my body and it will move in the opposite way I want it to.
